ttft: Client wall time from request submission to first token with the model already loaded.
total_s: Sum of server prompt_ms and predicted_ms, excluding model loading.
peak_gib: Peak charged to the shared engine ledger, including its runtime reservation.
scope: Single uncached request per fresh server, alternating handover and archive at ascending fixed budgets. Model load excluded. Windows file cache not reset.

profiles.16: Retained staging. The qualifying allocation survives the prompt-to-decode boundary.
profiles.10,12,14,18,20: Previously qualified NVFP4 profile with the same command, environment and release executable as the previous matrix.

comparisons: Historical one-request cells, not matched ABBA. Logical expert read bytes do not measure physical SSD traffic.
